On the happiest day of her life, Haru's world is suddenly torn asunder when the Vacuum devours her family. In shock, she swears revenge and in so doing unleashes her Soul Energy. Haru wields her sword with a fiery blend of guilt and atonement.

Fun is Erwin's greatest motivator – and that goes for his Soul Energy as well. Eyes wide open, he was the only one to walk into the Vacuum voluntarily. Even the apocalypse cannot wipe that broad grin off his cheerful face.

Lily derives her Soul Energy from her smouldering madness. A terrifying encounter with a beast from the Vacuum drove her over the edge. She tends to act the delicate, well-bred society girl, but behind the mask...

Jin is extremely noble and selfless, and his unerring passion feeds his Soul Energy. With complete disregard for his own well-being, he fights injustice wherever he sees it, for the good of humanity. Is that even possible in the ruins of this world...?
Sensitive Stella grew up around abusive and hostile people. Her Soul Energy manifests this sorrow. You wouldn't know it to look at those rosy little cheeks, but her Howling Guitar speaks volumes.

Deep down inside Iris boils a rage at a world gone awry which unleashes her Soul Energy. She perceives even herself with the same wrath and frustration, vowing to improve herself. But all she hears is a scornful echo which fills her with a livid emptiness.

A subterranean sewage tunnel that extends across Grace City. The Starry Forest League is planning a surprise attack on the Rapid Flame through this area and preparing the operation.

NED Company's secret military base. The Starry Forest League is carrying out an operation to expose the secret pact between NED Company and the Rapid Flame faction
and neutralize this place.
The central control system of Ruin Fortress, monitored by the high-powered AI Lucy. The Starry Forest League is attempting to retake this area to grant respite to the Near SoulWorker Search op.
The location of the Buster Cores, the main power source of Ruin Fortress. First of all, the deactivated Buster Cores need to be reactivated to restore power inside Ruin Fortress.
A secret laboratory inside of Ruin Fortress. Digger, the massive bore, is trying to execute something hidden in the bedrock. The Starry Forest League launches the operation to stop Digger.
A tracking operation is launched to catch Abel and Sion, who have fled to the Ark Ship: a gargantuan ship currently being built in secret in the outskirts of Ruin Fortress.

The Mist of Madness that Mad Edgar had sprayed still hung over Rocco Town, lurking.
Defend R Square against the major assault by Mad Edgar's Mannequins.
Edgar prepares the final parade to cap off the attack on Rocco Town. But his cruel festival will end here.
As the self-destruct button is activated, the last escape route from the N-102 laboratory opens.  Defeat the terrifying Beholder blocking the way and return safely.

The evil greed of the NED Company led to forbidden Experiments on live human subjects.
Stop the SoulWorker production project and grant peace to the victims.

Another Acheron entry route, where the ultimate unmanned robot lay sleeping, awaiting completion. You must break through the unmanned robot, awakened from its long sleep, and make the operation a success.
The surviving Soul Junk swarms and Edgar's doll units attack Rocco Town once again. You must defend Rocco Town, wrapped in thick fog and flames, to the very end.

A testing ground for the combat Skills of Starry Forest League soldiers.
Robots modified for testing await the SFL combatants.
Miriam rushed to the drill site, where work had been halted to rescue a child. But the sudden Soul Junk assault cut her off.

Dread, a Soul Junk roaming the boring site.
It destroyed Warren's hospital and plunged Rocco Town
into fear of an epidemic. Take it out before the epidemic spreads.

The boring site Miriam asked you to visit.
You must find and rescue the survivors
isolated by Soul Junk.

Ryu has gone alone to the site to confirm
reports that an awakened one has appeared. There's no telling what might happen.
Hurry and join him.

The Clown's invitation points to the deserted road of the main square.
What gifts await you there?

Countless mannequins crowd the roads around the main square.
A road that was once teeming with people and life
has turned into a road of soulless dolls.
To stop Big Puppet's advance, a helicopter will be needed that happens to belong to the NED Company. The mannequins have got to be stopped before they destroy the helicopter.
Operation [The Shield]. A dangerous plan to lure the Big Puppet in and make it self-destruct inside the protective wall. This is one operation that must succeed.

The search party sent to investigate the newly appeared dolls
has not returned.
Something feels wrong...

People turned into dolls,
an eerie tower, and dolls busily moving about...
Why are the dolls building a tower?

It was the tower that turned the people into mannequins.
Benjamin orders the tower's destruction, before it can wreak even more havoc.

The talking mannequin, codename: Jack The King
The only way to escape this situation is to defeat Jack The King.

Finally, the Blue Flame Clown has been tracked down.
He is in an abandoned hospital near Rocco Town. Find the vanguard and pursue the Blue Flame Clown.

You learned that you need a special badge
to reach the Blue Flame Clown.
The dolls inside the hospital carry the badges.
You reached the ward where the Blue Clown is based. The badge got you through the magnetic field, and you finally reached the Clown.

The Blue Flame Clown, Mad Edgar, fled and challenged you to a Outputdown in the circus tent on the hospital roof.
The final fight begins. He must be stopped, whatever the cost.

You have scarcely arrived in the new town and you aren't given a moment's rest. The next operation is already underway: Clear out the Soul Junks on the coastal road to secure the supply route to Candus City.

The reports from NED mercenaries of another powerful Soul Junk on the coastal road have been confirmed.
They say he is in a constant rage...

Recently, the coastal roads have experienced inexplicable earthquakes. There is a risk that this might cause flyovers and buildings to collapse. We must find out what is causing the earthquakes and solve the problem.
Yet another pack of Soul Junks has appeared. To defend Candus City, Lieutenant Colonel Aaron gives orders to eliminate the Soul Junks and detonate the last remaining supply route: the coastal tunnel.

Given permission by the NED Company, you have reached the subterranean sewage tunnels.
You nearly choke on the stench.
It feels like something really is alive here.

A foul stench from the underground waterways has begun to fill the city.
The cause is clearly in the waterways, but...
The NED Company has assembled a large squad of mercenaries and reSearchers and sent them into the sewers. Brooke, who grew suspicious of their activities, ordered them surveilled.
The arrival of the Junk Knight shocks the entire Starry Forest League. To hold the NED Company accountable, Brooke orders a sample procured from the Junk Knight.

You have learned that a NED Company dropship has crashed in a nearby residence.
We must learn what was on board.

The entire residence has turned into a Soul Junk's lair.
There is a highly contagious Soul Junk here. It should be killed before it gets outside.
Ralph says it is believed that Catherine is somewhere deep inside the residence. Go further into the residence find Catherine.

The Soul Junk Arachnes, who took Catherine,
is said to be hiding deep beneath the mansion.
Hurry and find Catherine.

The only antidote that can save Catherine, infected with Vacuum Vein, is inside NED Company's laboratory.
But the laboratory has already become a Soul Junk nest...
The second lab was a Soul Junk's lair as well. Who knows what made these places change so drastically, but the priority is to find the antidote for Catherine.

Racked with guilt over losing Catherine, Victor entered the depths of the laboratory alone to find the antidote.
He must be found before a Soul Junk gets him.
Henry says that to be effective, the antidote requires secretions from Beholder, and he also gave orders to demolish the laboratory.
Right after returning from Rocco Town, a massive army of Soul Junks attacked Candus City. To rescue the people, the control unit for the air raid shelter has got to be opened.
An inordinate number of Soul Junks were discovered inside the air raid shelter and on the way to the transport airship. They have to be killed first to protect people from being attacked.

Most of the inhabitants had been taken to safety. Only we and Catherine remained. It was at that very moment we discovered a mass of Soul Junks heading toward the transporter we were supposed to board.

After leaving Candus City behind, our flight began in earnest.
But the pack of Soul Junks attacked the airship with tenacity. Everyone was extremely concerned.
Although there was barely enough time to pursue Henry as it was, orders came down to bring back Vessi. The orders must be followed, for now.
The Rapid Flame Vessi which lusts for power. The Rapid Flame's assault squad is planning to invade Grace City via the motorway and awaits its opportunity.
A vehicle that Henry supposedly used has been found. Plenty of questions remain, but first we have got to save him before he is attacked by the Vessi.
No trace of Henry, whom we were searching for, but Rapid Flame executive "Scar" has appeared on the highway. To learn where Henry is, we must first subdue Scar.

After Henry broke into NED Company's headquarters,
a Rapid Flame ambush unit seized the building.
You don't like it, but you have to rescue him...

With Rapid Flame occupying NED Company,
the power supply is not reaching the building.

To restore NED Company's power,
the building's power must be activated manually.
Rapid Flame seems to have the "key".

To obtain evidence of the Candus City incident,
you must copy all data from the security box
inside NED Company.
Once Operation "Wolf Cry" is launched to defeat the Rapid Flame assault unit advancing on Highway 2, you must secure a firing position for the Hill Breaker.
Operation [Wolf Cry]'s target is to launch the high frequency rocket F-ARIA to neutralise Queen Garura, the attack squad's mainstay.
The Mountain Troll cannot move until F-ARIA is launched. Together with Kane Barrel, a SoulWorker of the Starry Forest League, the Rapid Flame attack squad must be stopped.
When his beloved mount Queen Garura is wounded, Falcon, commander of the Rapid Flame attack squad appears. Isn't it glorious when an enemy so rarely seen in person Outputs himself?
In a deserted place where silence smothers the roads, the cold rain in Deaf Town only spurs the ominous sense of foreboding.
Deaf Town, a little town near Grace City, is home to many people. With the war far off, Deaf Town has retained economic independence.
One can only hope this foreboding will be gone with the rain. There is no time! The SoulPath markers have to be set up to discover how Soul Energy flows through Deaf Town.
The ominous sense of foreboding became reality, after all. What are they after, doing such terrible things...? Well, we've got to Search for survivors first.
The alliance between Henry and the Rapid Flame faction has become reality. We must capture Henry, who has committed every atrocity, and make him atone for his crimes.
The place believed to be the Rapid Flame headquarters turned out to be a trap set by the NED Company working hand in glove with the Rapid Flame.
The NED Company's malignant stratagem placed Grace City in a perilous position from which it could not escape. We cannot let them die like that!
The Rapid Flame's kill squad is preventing the relief squad from carrying out the rescue op. If we are to save even one person, the enemies preventing it must be eliminated.
There are indications the NED Company hacked the military's Indra satellite. We need to trace the hack to find its source.
The trail leads to a place near the mountains, in the outskirts of Grace City. It's time to let them feel a punishing blade.
To locate Henry and Rauper, the interference signal that is crippling the military satellite has to be shut off.
Indra's scan of the facility interior Outputs two life forms, probably Henry and Rauper. Finally the time has come to avenge them.

A virtual training device developed for SoulWorkers. It materializes enemies registered in its database for combat that feels like the real thing. However, it consumes a lot of energy, so it can't be used often.
An area completely reduced to ruins by the Vacuum. Soul Junk continues to spawn here, so the Starry Forest League has designated it a restricted zone and bans civilians from entering.
A mysterious distortion that suddenly appeared released many dolls into the world. No one knows why they appeared. Only the dolls' power and their overwhelming hostility were clear.

An upside down world.
Stunned people.
Unbelievable stories.
Everything I knew has come crashing down.
What... what's going to become of me?

When I woke up, the world had changed.
Monsters roam and people use supernatural powers.
The world I was trying to create... was spread out before my eyes.
How could I not get excited about this?

A world where common sense no longer applies...
But still.
I have always gotten everything I wanted.
I'll do the same in this world.

They say a lot has changed in the last 15 years.
They say that survival is all that matters in today's world.
Huh... what can I say?
Survival has always been all that mattered to me.

It seems 15 years passed before I knew it.
Is this how a hibernating bear feels...?
Everyone keeps talking about difficult things... and I'm starving...
...But I'm not lonely, because everyone is here.

The world I knew is gone.
Everything seems to strange and unpleasant. I don't want to stay here a minute longer.
But I've got to face it.
This is the world I'm going to be living in.
I've got to persevere and tough it out.

Hello.
I am "Edgar the Clown", who wanders this mingled world in search of the ultimate show.
You must be quite surprised to receive this sudden letter.
But I could not help wanting to tell you how deeply I admire your power.
Your power was the most beautiful and striking thing in my short life.
Gaudy yet plain, beautiful yet foul,
and... peaceful yet destructive...
I agonized over how to express these feelings, which feel ready to burst, and finally reached a conclusion.
I will send you... a small gift.
It is meant to show my respect for your power, so please do not refuse it.
You can find the gift at the place you call the "Shopping Street".
I only hope... that you will like it.
- From Edgar the Clown -

I can feel the distance between us closing, little by little.
Sooner or later we will meet,
and the longer we wait, the more brilliantly the moment of meeting shines.
To set a dramatic stage, I have prepared a little game.
With your current strength, you cannot reach the front of my room.
But if you wear the badge my subordinates carry,
I have arranged it so you can pass through as if walking through a forest at dawn.
Please hurry.
Before this longing for you turns to hatred...
- From Edgar the Clown -

- Report: Amaryllis -

1. Added Soul Energy resistance to SJ-DS-01. Condition is highly unstable.

2. SJ-DS-01 has been found to be able to parasitize humans, the hosts of Soul Energy.
A parasitized human continuously loses Soul Energy, their skin hardens like plaster, and they become food for SJ-DS-01.

3. SJ-DS-01 is named the Dignity Snatcher. It has been revealed that the Dignity Snatcher holds a fixed total amount of Soul Energy inside. However, an ordinary human does not have enough Soul Energy to fill that total. The current total cannot be measured.

- Report: Tempest -
1. The fuselage is an apparatus assembled with utmost precision. Based on our data on Rapid Flame technology, we can conclude that we do not have the means to create a Rapid Flame of our own with our methods. We hypothesise that an external force was used to produce it.

2. The weapon fires highly concentrated Desire Energy.

3. The Armor includes a special wire and a crane which can lift 700 kg.
We estimate the Armor's attack damage to be devastating.

4. The special wire is capable of storing and transmitting Soul Energy.

On a gloomy day.
The child's fury was predictable. It's difficult to comprehend people who call this phenomena a disaster. The truth is, we have sinned and the time has come to atone for our sins. As the representative of all other children, the time has come to hand out just punishment. Even if it is called revenge, I will accept it as atonement.

On a snowy day.
Foolish people have caused the child to fall into a deep sleep again. They took comfort in the thought that it would all be over once the child was asleep. The foolish belief that the NED Company would save us makes me mad with rage. They will bury everyone who knows the truth. As though nothing had ever happened.

On a clear day.
After it was decided to mark this place off-limits, everyone but the management board was left behind in this hell. It won't be long before everyone is dead. Indeed. We have sinned. It is only just to die like this. I do not fear what we face.

Arin, who has been serving as Force Strike’s temporary Operator and a supporter of Supernaturals, was relocated due to recent events.
She is nervous about taking on a new, unfamiliar role as aircraft support, but moreso that her clients are Cloudream’s heroes; SoulWorkers.
She has quite the strange habit of stuttering on an everyday basis but speaking quite smoothly when she’s nervous, creating praise for what she does.

The girl faced the vengeance welling up from within.
Even after she achieved it, would she live on forever seeking something to hate...?
And so she resolved to hold a belief that would support her firm will, rather than vengeance.
As the SoulWorker of Fighting Spirit, Haru Estia -

The boy had never accomplished anything because he refused to connect with people.
Promises, friendship, love, trust... the complex, incalculable exchanges built between people. He had never cared about the human soul and emotions that even a genius cannot fully grasp. Until he met a girl who said she liked him...
Having lost the one to whom he should have kept his promise, the boy sublimated that emptiness into a vow toward an unattainable goal.
As the SoulWorker of Vows, Erwin Arclight -

A person who finds no value in themselves does not fear death.
One such girl began to wonder. What had she grown strong for? What were the intense emotions and desires that had trained her power in the Vacuum? Above all... she could not explain the unpleasant feeling that lingered in her hands.
The girl finally realized that merely swinging her scythe like a madwoman could not fill her heart. And so she willingly offered her life in order to reach a more satisfying final duel.
As the SoulWorker of Resolve, Lily Bloommerchen -

The one at the front is always alone. Whoever walks ahead must endure the loneliness of having no one in front of them.
The boy thought that a hero is someone who clears a rough path for those behind and is first to face the threats ahead. And that no companion would ever walk in front of him.
But now he can hear the voices that, crushed by responsibility and guilt, never reached him before. The people behind never leave a hero alone. They cheer him on and support him when he is about to fall. After long hardship and experience, the boy finally realized this.
As the SoulWorker of Trust, Jin Seipatsu -

Fear of sorrow and a refusal to cry had guided the girl, and tormented her at the same time.
The other personality, sleeping deep inside, trusted no one and bore her wounds alone in the Vacuum. Endless distrust of humans... the wounds of a pure child would surely remain as irreparable scars.
But now it is different. The girl chose to trust humans again and wished to sing together with them. Because she no longer wanted to cry or fear sorrow.
As the SoulWorker of Hope, Stella Unibell -

Anger becomes strength only when it is not aimed at oneself.
To be angry at oneself means to feel one's responsibility keenly. But the girl could not do that, and always blamed adults when things went wrong.
Not all of it was wrong, but she realized that such an attitude gains nothing. She scolded herself and found the courage to take responsibility.
As the SoulWorker of Valor, Iris Yuma -

Just as humans do not introduce themselves as humans, cats do not introduce themselves as cats.
The girl kept insisting she was a cat. That is exactly why she understood better than anyone that she was neither human nor cat, and could not accept it. It meant she was nothing but a monster.
A monster with a human body... Though she could never become human, she wanted to be a cat who stays by humans' side, and agonized over what to do. The answer she finally reached was to walk beside humans, just like a cat.
As a cat... and as the SoulWorker of Determination, Chii Aruel -

Not so much a SoulWorker as something close to one...
The girl hated most this identity given by others, which shackled her. The fate of a Near SoulWorker, whose very existence is already a finished form, was no different.
Welling anger, a desire for revenge, and a fierce will to survive will change her past, present, and even her future.
As the SoulWorker of Renewal, Ephnel -

What is the difference between a slave and a subordinate, between a servant and a vassal?
A sage once said that a vassal chooses their lord. The girl who left Ayame, who had forced her into obedience, decided to follow a new lord of her own free will.
Even if he is lacking, she swore to devote her loyalty by her own will.

She's always cheerful and kind, kind of our mascot... Even in hard times, just seeing her cheers me up.
In a world like this, it's fine to have someone like her, right? She is a bit mischievous, though...
Yes, Catherine is truly the mascot of Candus City.
I'm sure anyone who sees her will want to dote on her.

I am Arua! The decurion serving the radiant providence and eternal star, Lady Lunar Nox, of the Nihil Kingdom!
I have the wits to bewilder a guard captain and the valor to surpass a thousand-man commander!
What's greatest is that, despite having both, I stand on the front line as a mere decurion!
W-well, there was some help from a few people... Oh, never mind such trivial things!
Just remember that I am the decurion of the honorable Lady Lunar Nox!

What are you staring at? Do you find this tiny form that amusing?
Well, never mind. Appearance is one of the most unreliable ways to express oneself.
Hm, you want to know about me? What a nosy one. ...Fine, I'll tell you to pass the time.
Back in my homeland, I made my living beating up people I disliked, and in doing so I found a mass of energy I had never seen.
As I chased that energy, I found myself somewhere else. That was Stair Ouroboros... the land of the Vessi.
The new land wasn't bad. In fact, it was good. The enemies and energy I tasted for the first time made me stronger and entertained me.
No one had Void energy like mine, but that was enough for me.
...Until I was sealed in the Vacuum.

Rapid Flame's one of four Leaders leading the Shock Troop.
She has the best combat style aside from the head, Flemma.

A Rapid Flame executive and Assault Squad Leader.
Apart from the leader, Flemma, he boasts the highest attack power.
His great pride in his brute strength and his fighting spirit are what sustain him.

A Rapid Flame executive and Raid Squad Leader.
He commands powerful raid squads, led by the monstrous bird "Queen Garura".
True to a Rapid Flame Vessi, he has a strong will to fight.

An awakened one artificially created by NED Company.
He has high intelligence, but it is merely a by-product of experiments.
Mixing the mucus from a Beholder's eyeball with certain drugs and administering it to a human body produces two results: neutralization and strengthening of Vacuum Vein.

A Rapid Flame executive and Assassination Squad Leader.
Compared to other executives, her abilities are lesser, but she is considered the most threatening for her speed and skill in assassination and destroying strongholds.

Hello, hello! Welcome to Betty's "Ask Me Anything" corner!
Well, who do you want to know about?
SoulWorkers? ...Hmm, that'll cost you.
Now then, I have plenty of information about SoulWorkers.
What? You already know this? That can't be...!
Who on earth told you that!? ...Huh, me?

Mr. Block, SoulWorkers really are heroes, right?
Have you ever met a SoulWorker, Mr. Block?
...They're in Grace City? Wow, then let's go meet them together! I want to meet them too!
My dream is to help everyone in the future!
I always say it, but I want to become a hero who helps everyone, like you and Daddy.
Yes, like Burning Red! Hehe!

Munch munch... Hm, my homeland?
Hmm... If you give me that red food, I think I can remember.
Oh, you'll give it to me!? Thank you!
I remember my homeland perfectly!
Lots of armor, a white royal palace, and a wide garden...
Oh, right! The garden is truly beautiful!
Lady Lunar Nox's predecessor as thousand-man commander, Lord Tanas, tended it himself!
Lady Lunar Nox always said she tended it herself... but Lord Tanas laughed every time she said so, so it must have been a lie.
Yes, that garden was always beautiful.
I miss the days I laughed with Lady Lunar Nox while strolling there...
Inside the palace? Nothing much. Just pointless statues and portraits.
And a palace without Lady Lunar Nox... doesn't matter at all.
Yes, it doesn't matter...

I suffered long from emptiness and loneliness.
I enjoyed fighting the Vessi, but it didn't last long, and I thought I was doomed to be bored forever in this deep, dark Vacuum... until they came.
They were interesting folks who used Soul Energy, and since I couldn't eat them anyway, I played with them.
Having lived for years too many to count, I have few worthy rivals. But they entertained me.
Just breaking my long, boring days was reason enough to like them.
They say they will kill a god. Interesting. They intend to slay the god of Desire Energy, whom even I could not defeat, and cut off their grudge.
In the end, I decided to help them. That, too, will be a pleasure.

My past?
Hmm, why do you want to know? There's nothing interesting about it.
For the Vessi... no, for us at Rapid Flame, fighting and taking is the way of life.
Individual strength is life, and it's also pride.
And I'm no different. I killed plenty to become an executive.
Well, I'm not that strong, so I've used underhanded tricks, but anyone who gets fooled deserves it.
I climbed up killing them one by one... and Kent? Don't make me laugh!
I refused to follow a guy like that, so I walked out.

Void hypo... Ohh, a "hypothesis about" the Vacuum!
Sorry, but I'm no good at science, so I don't really get it. Ahaha.
What, that's not the kind of hypo? Oh, Major Martin, you're such a joker!
No no, I'm a communications officer! Hypo-thesis is beyond me, hypo-thesis!
Hypo... thetical...

...This flower?
I don't know its name... but my daughter used to tend it, so I'm just doing the same.
I have no ability or qualification to raise anything.
My daughter always looked at this flower and said it was dazzlingly beautiful.
She probably didn't know its name either.
To me, only my daughter... only Catherine was always a dazzlingly beautiful flower.
Yes, it was always so...

Sora Nox and Lady Lunar Nox?
Hm, you're curious about the two who are so praised?
All right, I'll tell you thoroughly!
Setting Sora Nox aside... Lady Lunar Nox was a noble person.
Unlike Sora Nox, who was quite a tomboy, she always spent time in the palace library. We got along well, though.
But Ji Nox seemed to take offense at that. He said Sora Nox should inherit the throne to restore the Nihil Kingdom...
Then suddenly monsters fell from the sky, the royal castle was half destroyed, and because of those fools I was separated from Lady Lunar Nox...
I came all the way here risking my life, too.
If it's here... I'm sure to find her.

Martin, was it? He turned out to be rather interesting.
We talked about all sorts of things, hobbies and food. I didn't understand much, though.
Good friends? Don't be absurd.
Words carry the speaker's wishes and desires.
In the Vacuum, those attract faint Desire Energy, and it tastes rather good.
Setting you aside, Desire Energy isn't good for those with only a trace of Soul Energy like him, is it?
It's inconvenient, but I get a good meal and they are protected from Desire Energy. We both benefit. Heh heh heh...

If God is good and omnipotent, why does "evil" exist in the world...?
Humans do think of interesting things. But no one can answer it.
Because usually the answer is one of three.
God does not exist. Or exists but is not omnipotent. Or is not good...
And the god of the human world was not omnipotent, while the god of our world was evil.
He had no interest in us, his creations and charges, and even found us boring.
We lived in our own way too, but he simply treated us as worthless by his own standards.
...I'll make him pay. We have every right to.

Golden Citadel is a raid for 1 to 4 players.
In Golden Citadel you can obtain various items, including crafting materials for the "Aurate" set, which can be equipped at Lv. 55 or higher.

Golden Citadel has 4 different halls to clear, and each hall has unique attack patterns.

Hall of Discord: Boss [Juggernaut] - After a certain period of time, summon Obelisk that uses Self-Destruct Attack.
Hall of Chaos: Boss [Pandemonium] - Fire multiple spheres that give 3 kinds of Debuffs.
Hall of Aeons: Boss [Eternity] - Erupt lava throughout the map, and gives continuous damages until the Flame Crystal is destroyed.
Hall of Depravity: Boss [Apocalypse] - Use blizzard throughout the map and it gives Freezing Debuff. Must press the Heat Switch to gain Frost Resistance Buff.
Hall of Ruin: Final Boss [Ultimatum] - Summon the shadows of bosses in previous halls. It will be a difficult battle.

Violent Sun is a raid for 1 to 4 players.
Fight Flemma in 3 phases; clearing it earns various items, including crafting materials for the "Pale Ash" set, which can be equipped at Lv. 72 or higher.

Flemma uses stronger skills as phases change.
Learn the attack patterns of each phase to beat her.

Phases 1 and 2 have time limits, and if you cannot clear them in time, you cannot advance to the next phase.
Rewards differ depending on the phase you reached by the end of the raid.

Recommended: Lv. 72 or Higher
Boss: Flemma

Phase 1 has a time limit. Not possible to move on to Phase 2 if players don't clear within the time limit.
Phase 1: Basic Skills / Grabs and Throws / Consecutive Range Explosions / and more

Grabs and Throws: Flemma designates one target and grabs and throws that character. If any character is within the range, there has a chance to be caught. (Even the character is not the designated target)
Consecutive Range Explosions: Flemma strikes the ground 3 times, gives 50% DMG of Max HP to all targets on the ground. Enable to avoid this explosion by jumping at the timing of hitting the hammer.

Recommended Level: Lv. 72 or higher
Boss: Flemma

Phase 2 also has a time limit. Clear it within the limit to advance to Phase 3.
In Phase 2, she also uses skills such as powerful charges and flame floors.

The charge attack stuns all users and then charges at one of them. Lead the targeted user to the highway rubble in the map background to leave Flemma groggy.
The flame floor gives a buff to one random user and a debuff that deals heavy damage to the other 3. After a set time, step into the blue circle that appears around the buffed party member to remove the debuff.

Recommended: Lv. 72 or Higher
Boss: Flemma

There is No Time Limit for Phase 3.
Phase 3: Phase 1 & 2 Skills / Meteor Attack / Counter-Attack / and more

Meteor Attack: Flemma drops flame meteors across the map. At the same time as the Meteor Attack, Flemma's subordinates begin firing straight flame blasting beam.

Counter-Attack: Flemma takes counterattack stance. He hits the ground hard and counterattacks when being attacked during this stance. It is important not to attack Flemma in a counter-attack posture.

There will be a (low) chance to obtain [Pale Ashes Hero] Equipment and Rapid Flame concept Costumes.

Recommended Level: Lv. 76 or higher
Boss: Tenebris

Tenebris uses stronger skills as phases change.
In Phase 1, he uses basic attacks, grab attacks, and light and dark attribute skills.
Examples of attack patterns include a beam fired after gathering all party members in the center and summoning a clone, and summoning Bomb Puppets and Force Fists.
When Tenebris draws a sword and summons 3 fields, move to the field that matches the sword's color.

The Phase 1 time limit is 3 minutes.
If you cannot clear it in time, you cannot advance to the next phase, and you earn the reward when Tenebris is defeated.

Recommended Level: Lv. 76 or higher
Boss: Tenebris

Tenebris uses stronger skills as phases change.
In Phase 2, he uses entirely different skills from Phase 1 and elemental attacks that require cooperation with party members.
When he freezes party members at random, he matches the field colors, so listen carefully to Tenebris's lines.
If he summons 4 summons at specific positions, you must defeat them and move to a field of a different color.
Pay attention to the summons' colors.

Phase 2 has no time limit.
